mapper.sql: F.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN AS formTemplateSn, F.CAT_SN AS catSn, C.CAT_NM AS catNm, F.FORM_VER_NO AS formVersion, FIRST_STEP.SVC_REQ_STEP_KEY AS firstStepKey, F.FORM_SUBTTL AS subtitle, CAST(F.FORM_UI_META_JSON AS CHAR) AS uiMetaJson
mapper.select: /* ServiceRequestFormMapper.findActiveFormHeaders */ SELECT FROM SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL F JOIN CATEGORY C ON C.CAT_SN = F.CAT_SN JOIN SVC_REQ_STEP_DEF FIRST_STEP ON FIRST_STEP.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN = F.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN AND FIRST_STEP.SVC_REQ_STEP_SN = F.FIRST_STEP_SN WHERE F.FORM_ACTV_YN = 'Y' AND F.FORM_USE_YN = 'Y' AND C.CAT_USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY C.CAT_SORT_NO, C.CAT_SN

/* ServiceRequestFormMapper.findActiveFormHeader */ SELECT FROM SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL F JOIN CATEGORY C ON C.CAT_SN = F.CAT_SN JOIN SVC_REQ_STEP_DEF FIRST_STEP ON FIRST_STEP.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN = F.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN AND FIRST_STEP.SVC_REQ_STEP_SN = F.FIRST_STEP_SN WHERE F.CAT_SN = #{catSn} AND F.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN = #{formTemplateSn} AND F.FORM_ACTV_YN = 'Y' AND F.FORM_USE_YN = 'Y' AND C.CAT_USE_YN = 'Y'

/* ServiceRequestFormMapper.findFormHeaderByTemplateSn */ SELECT FROM SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL F JOIN CATEGORY C ON C.CAT_SN = F.CAT_SN JOIN SVC_REQ_STEP_DEF FIRST_STEP ON FIRST_STEP.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN = F.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN AND FIRST_STEP.SVC_REQ_STEP_SN = F.FIRST_STEP_SN WHERE F.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN = #{formTemplateSn} AND F.FORM_USE_YN = 'Y'

/* ServiceRequestFormMapper.findSteps */ SELECT S.SVC_REQ_STEP_SN AS stepSn, S.SVC_REQ_STEP_KEY AS stepKey, S.SVC_REQ_STEP_TTL AS title, S.SVC_REQ_STEP_EXPLN AS description, S.SVC_REQ_STEP_TYPE_CD AS type, N.SVC_REQ_STEP_KEY AS nextStepKey, S.SVC_REQ_STEP_SNSTV_YN AS sensitiveYn, S.SVC_REQ_STEP_PBLC_YN AS publicYn, CAST(S.SVC_REQ_STEP_SORT_NO AS SIGNED) AS sortNo FROM SVC_REQ_STEP_DEF S LEFT JOIN SVC_REQ_STEP_DEF N ON N.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN = S.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN AND N.SVC_REQ_STEP_SN = S.NEXT_STEP_SN WHERE S.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN = #{formTemplateSn} AND S.SVC_REQ_STEP_USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY S.SVC_REQ_STEP_SORT_NO, S.SVC_REQ_STEP_SN

/* ServiceRequestFormMapper.findStepOptions */ SELECT O.SVC_REQ_STEP_OPT_SN AS optionSn, O.SVC_REQ_STEP_SN AS stepSn, O.SVC_REQ_STEP_OPT_KEY AS optionKey, O.SVC_REQ_STEP_OPT_VAL AS value, O.SVC_REQ_STEP_OPT_LABEL AS label, O.SVC_REQ_STEP_OPT_SUBTTL AS subtitle, N.SVC_REQ_STEP_KEY AS nextStepKey, CAST(O.SVC_REQ_STEP_OPT_SORT_NO AS SIGNED) AS sortNo FROM SVC_REQ_STEP_OPT_DEF O LEFT JOIN SVC_REQ_STEP_DEF N ON N.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN = O.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN AND N.SVC_REQ_STEP_SN = O.NEXT_STEP_SN WHERE O.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN = #{formTemplateSn} AND O.SVC_REQ_STEP_OPT_USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY O.SVC_REQ_STEP_SN, O.SVC_REQ_STEP_OPT_SORT_NO, O.SVC_REQ_STEP_OPT_SN

/* ServiceRequestFormMapper.findFields */ SELECT D.SVC_REQ_FIELD_SN AS fieldSn, D.SVC_REQ_STEP_SN AS stepSn, D.SVC_REQ_FIELD_KEY AS fieldKey, D.SVC_REQ_FIELD_LABEL AS label, D.SVC_REQ_FIELD_TYPE_CD AS type, D.SVC_REQ_FIELD_PH AS placeholder, D.SVC_REQ_FIELD_EXPLN AS description, D.SVC_REQ_FIELD_REQ_YN AS requiredYn, D.SVC_REQ_FIELD_DIGIT_YN AS requireDigitYn, D.SVC_REQ_FIELD_SNSTV_YN AS sensitiveYn, D.SVC_REQ_FIELD_PBLC_YN AS publicYn, D.SVC_REQ_FIELD_MAX_CNT AS maxSelections, CAST(D.SVC_REQ_FIELD_SORT_NO AS SIGNED) AS sortNo, CAST(D.SVC_REQ_FIELD_UI_META_JSON AS CHAR) AS uiMetaJson FROM SVC_REQ_FIELD_DEF D WHERE D.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN = #{formTemplateSn} AND D.SVC_REQ_FIELD_USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY D.SVC_REQ_STEP_SN, D.SVC_REQ_FIELD_SORT_NO, D.SVC_REQ_FIELD_SN

/* ServiceRequestFormMapper.findFieldOptions */ SELECT O.SVC_REQ_FIELD_OPT_SN AS optionSn, O.SVC_REQ_FIELD_SN AS fieldSn, O.SVC_REQ_FIELD_OPT_KEY AS optionKey, O.SVC_REQ_FIELD_OPT_VAL AS value, O.SVC_REQ_FIELD_OPT_LABEL AS label, CAST(O.SVC_REQ_FIELD_OPT_SORT_NO AS SIGNED) AS sortNo FROM SVC_REQ_FIELD_OPT_DEF O WHERE O.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN = #{formTemplateSn} AND O.SVC_REQ_FIELD_OPT_USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY O.SVC_REQ_FIELD_SN, O.SVC_REQ_FIELD_OPT_SORT_NO, O.SVC_REQ_FIELD_OPT_SN

/* ServiceRequestFormMapper.findFieldRules */ SELECT R.SVC_REQ_FIELD_RULE_SN AS ruleSn, R.TARGET_FIELD_SN AS targetFieldSn, SOURCE_STEP.SVC_REQ_STEP_KEY AS sourceStepKey, SOURCE_FIELD.SVC_REQ_FIELD_KEY AS sourceFieldKey, SOURCE_FIELD.SVC_REQ_FIELD_LABEL AS sourceFieldLabel, COALESCE(STEP_OPT.SVC_REQ_STEP_OPT_VAL, FIELD_OPT.SVC_REQ_FIELD_OPT_VAL) AS compareValue, R.RULE_OPERATOR_CD AS operator, R.RULE_ACTION_CD AS action, CAST(R.SVC_REQ_FIELD_RULE_SORT_NO AS SIGNED) AS sortNo FROM SVC_REQ_FIELD_RULE_DEF R LEFT JOIN SVC_REQ_STEP_DEF SOURCE_STEP ON SOURCE_STEP.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN = R.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN AND SOURCE_STEP.SVC_REQ_STEP_SN = R.SOURCE_STEP_SN LEFT JOIN SVC_REQ_FIELD_DEF SOURCE_FIELD ON SOURCE_FIELD.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN = R.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN AND SOURCE_FIELD.SVC_REQ_FIELD_SN = R.SOURCE_FIELD_SN LEFT JOIN SVC_REQ_STEP_OPT_DEF STEP_OPT ON STEP_OPT.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN = R.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN AND STEP_OPT.SVC_REQ_STEP_OPT_SN = R.COMPARE_STEP_OPT_SN LEFT JOIN SVC_REQ_FIELD_OPT_DEF FIELD_OPT ON FIELD_OPT.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN = R.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN AND FIELD_OPT.SVC_REQ_FIELD_OPT_SN = R.COMPARE_FIELD_OPT_SN WHERE R.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN = #{formTemplateSn} AND R.SVC_REQ_FIELD_RULE_USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY R.SVC_REQ_FIELD_RULE_SORT_NO, R.SVC_REQ_FIELD_RULE_SN
